author: GameTrailers
description:
Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition comes to macOS this May. Lead diverse civilisations spanning a thousand years of history. Grow a Dark Age hamlet into an Imperial Age citadel. Build a thriving economy, assemble your armies, and do battle across historical single-player campaigns, the hugely replayable skirmish mode, and with other macOS players in online multiplayer.
Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition lands on Steam for macOS on May 28, with a Mac App Store release to come later in the year.
title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Official macOS Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Immersion update release trailer for Seafarer: The Ship Sim, a naval simulation game developed by Astragon. Players can now access The Immersion update, which focuses on making Seafarers feel more alive. The update also includes a reworked campaign, a new mission, and new inspection gameplay. The Immersion update for Seafarer: The Ship Sim is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Seafarer: The Ship Sim - Official The Immersion Update Release Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Kunimitsu is ready to show her evolved Ninjutsu arts! Watch the latest Tekken 8 gameplay trailer for the fighting game to see Kunimitsu in action. Kunimitsu will be available in Tekken 8 in Early Access on May 27, with a release on June 1.
title: Tekken 8 - Official Kunimitsu Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The Challenge of the Champion threatens the planet, and the Fighting Avengers are the third team to answer the call! Led by Captain America and featuring Iron Man, the Fighting Avengers bring two new characters into the fight: Shuri as Black Panther, wielding her aggressive style and Wakandan weaponry, and Hulk, angrier than ever and ready to smash his opponents! MARVEL Tokon: Fighting Souls coming to PS5 and PC on August 6, 2026!
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Fighting Avengers Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Star Wars Droid Tycoon Trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person battle royale developed by Epic Games. Build and customize droids using authentic Star Wars blueprints, manage your workshop and factory systems, and unlock rare components and special missions. Craft the galaxy, one droid at a time.
title: Fortnite x Star Wars - Official Droid Tycoon Trailer
